title: Measuring Colombia's Informal Output: Relative Earnings and Identification in a Bayesian Two-Sector Model, 1993-2026
abstract: arXiv:2611.28297v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: How much of Colombia's measured output is produced by informal work? The answer cannot be read from the labor-informality rate: Colombia combines an informality rate above 50% with a much smaller informal share of output, because informal work is less productive. We estimate a Bayesian two-sector business-cycle model on quarterly national accounts and on reconstructed employment and informality series for 1993-2026. Identification comes from a new quarterly series of informal-to-formal labor earnings built from household-survey microdata for 2007-2026. Formal production uses capital and labor, informal production is labor based, and an accounting relationship maps relative earnings, the informality rate and the formal capital share into the informal output share. translated_title: 衡量哥伦比亚的非正规产出：1993-2026年贝叶斯两部门模型中的相对收入与识别
translated_abstract: 哥伦比亚的测算产出中有多少是由非正规工作生产的？这个答案无法从劳动非正规率中直接读出：哥伦比亚的非正规就业率超过50%，但非正规产出份额却小得多，这是因为非正规工作的生产率较低。我们基于季度国民账户以及1993-2026年重建的就业和非正规性序列，估计了一个贝叶斯两部门经济周期模型。识别依据来自一个新的季度非正规与正规劳动收入之比序列，该序列由2007-2026年的住户调查微观数据构建。正规部门生产使用资本和劳动，非正规部门生产仅以劳动为基础，一个会计恒等式将相对收入、非正规率和正规资本份额映射为非正规产出份额。我们证明，仅靠总量数据无法确定非正规部门的规模，而相对收入能够识别其季度路径：自2007年以来该路径保持不变……
tldr: 该研究通过贝叶斯两部门模型和基于住户调查微观数据构建的非正规与正规劳动相对收入序列，识别出哥伦比亚的非正规产出份额远低于其超过50%的非正规就业率，并证明相对收入是确定非正规部门季度路径的关键识别依据。
en_tdlr: This paper uses a Bayesian two-sector model and a new quarterly series of informal-to-formal relative earnings built from household survey microdata to show that Colombia's informal output share is much smaller than its 50%+ informality rate, and that relative earnings are the key to identifying the quarterly path of the informal sector.
